summary: Completed frontend-only permission regression on preview URL for فرج1 and route-guard scenarios. Requested archive/vehicle permission flows pass after stable-wait recheck.
action_items: Fix Sidebar recent-pages click handler: onNavigate is referenced but not defined (potential runtime error when clicking recent page item).
Resolve duplicate route declaration for '/templates' in App.js to avoid ambiguous/unreachable route behavior.
Provide /app/auth_testing.md at documented path (playbook file missing, optional auth-playbook checks could not run).
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx uses onNavigate inside recent-pages button click without defining it in component scope, which can throw ReferenceError at runtime.
App.js declares '/templates' route twice (Templates and TemplatesManager), creating route shadowing and maintenance risk.
Dashboard.jsx and VehicleDetails.jsx are very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk and making permission-related defects harder to isolate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://finance-overhaul-7.preview.emergentagent.com: فرج1 login reaches dashboard; /archive accessible with cards loaded (119 cards) and matches /api/vehicles count (119); first archive card opens /vehicle/{id}?source=archive&editMode=full without permission denied; archive edit buttons visible while delete buttons hidden for فرج1; synthetic user with archive.create=true and vehicles.create=false can open /new-vehicle; synthetic user with neither archive/vehicles permission is blocked from /vehicle/{id} via redirect to allowed route (/).
rca of the issue: Initial quick run showed archive loading spinner and zero cards because assertions occurred before archive fetch settled; recheck with longer wait confirmed vehicles load correctly and requested permission fixes are functioning. Also observed many net::ERR_ABORTED console lines during multi-navigation automation; these align with request cancellation on route changes and were not reproduced as functional failures in steady-state checks.
